_comment: TODO-074 rendered positives, hand labels (bench/wrapping/rendered.mjs captures the set). One entry per examined element of each en-XA screen, paired with its en twin. rows/base_rows were counted on the screenshots (Read) and checked against the dump frame heights. wrapped: a one-line control label (button, chip, segment, tab, nav title) with 2+ rows in en-XA and 1 in en. orphan: a text element of 2-3 rows whose last row is one word at most a third as wide as the widest row (widths measured on the screenshot). Entries with in_sidecar false are on screen but have no text element in the sidecar. sample-game (both platforms) draws its text on a canvas and has no text elements: not labeled.

rules.wrapped: control kind (button, chip, segment, tab, nav) and rows >= 2 and base_rows == 1
rules.orphan: rows 2-3, last row one word, last row width <= 1/3 of the widest row
